# `aitbc simulate result`

Get the results of a completed simulation.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc simulate result [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--simulation-id` | text | — | yes | The Simulation id. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc simulate result --simulation-id <simulation_id>
```
